objective.name: pilot_definition_data
objective.description: Defines the content (substance) of a pilot_definition Matter: the persistent configuration used to instantiate the cognition of a generic pilot.

functional._id_note: Required. Stable identifier of the pilot definition.
functional._prompt_note: Required. Cognitive instructions defining the role, perspective, behavior, and decision principles of the pilot.
functional._model_note: Required. Model configuration or model reference used by the pilot when performing inference.
functional._parameters_note: Required or open according to the consuming LLM wrapper. Holds inference parameters associated with the selected model.
functional._default_projection_note: Required. Deterministic default projection used when constructing the continuity context for inference.
functional._known_capacities_note: Required. Stable capacities explicitly known by this pilot definition. Dynamically discovered capacities remain continuity-local and are not written back automatically.
functional._rules_note: Required or open collection of explicit behavioral, operational, or domain rules supplied to the pilot.
functional._limits_note: Optional. Operational ceilings of the pilot. max_inferences_per_message lowers, never raises, the default ceiling of cognitive chain steps allowed for one message. context_tokens is the context window of the model, in tokens; without it no compaction pressure is computed. compaction_advised_ratio (default 0.60) is the part of the window from which the pilot is invited to compact; compaction_required_ratio (default 0.85) the part from which a succession is imposed. wait_timeout_s (default 3600) is how long a wait group waits for an answer that never comes: past it, every missing answer is resolved as an error answer (timeout) and the pilot decides.
functional._allowed_capacities_note: Optional. Patterns of the capacity references the pilot may invoke; * matches any text, / included (for example /root/vocabulary.* or */read.meaning). Absent: every capacity is allowed. Present: only these, plus the contract readers /root/read.capacity and */read.meaning that agentic_core exposes to every pilot. forbidden_capacities wins over it.
functional._forbidden_capacities_note: Optional. Patterns of the capacity references the pilot may never invoke, whatever allowed_capacities says (for example /root/edit.* or */wrapper.*). Applied by agentic_core before any effect of the output: it is code, not a request made to the model.
functional._allowed_contexts_note: Optional. Absolute paths of contexts: a capacity addressed to one of them, or to a context nested in it, may be invoked. Combines with allowed_capacities (a listed capacity or a listed context is enough). forbidden_capacities and forbidden_contexts win.
functional._forbidden_contexts_note: Optional. Absolute paths of contexts: no capacity addressed to one of them, or to a context nested in it, may be invoked, whatever the allowed lists say.
